boundaries.necessity: Python/Lua user code must not share address space with hardware owners; crash and timeout isolation per generation.
boundaries.trust: Worker holds no camera/serial/socket handle; every value crosses via typed MessagePack IPC and is validated at decode.
boundaries.distribution: n/a (same package: [[bin]] pokecon-worker + worker-binary feature, not a separate crate).

boundaries.necessity: Only closed, typed values may cross the process boundary; native handles and private objects are rejected at decode, never serialized.
boundaries.trust: Envelope 5 kind, IpcValue 9 closed values, 1048576B上限, 6 forbidden wire markers, 7 non-public payload cases rejected at decode.
boundaries.distribution: n/a (wire schema pinned in-registry; generated artifacts must not redefine it).

boundaries.necessity: LAN-exposed HTTP surface serves untrusted networks and untrusted dynamic load_content intake; every request is allowlisted before it reaches handlers.
boundaries.trust: Host/Origin allowlist with VARY Origin; load_content is untrusted intake validated before commit, never a direct state write.
boundaries.distribution: n/a (transport policy, not a packaged artifact).

boundaries.necessity: Serial enumeration, notifications, and shared-memory teardown differ per OS; cfg-gated code keeps one crate while honoring each platform's API.
boundaries.trust: n/a (platform selection, not a trust boundary; wrong-platform code must not compile in).
boundaries.distribution: n/a (same crate; per-OS packaging is os-bundle-distribution).

boundaries.necessity: Each OS installs through its native bundle format with signed provenance; the runtime must never redefine the distribution manifest.
boundaries.trust: signing-inputs.json policy with canonical_sha256 and per-file sha256/size; payload, expanded-tree, and outer-installer manifests compared in three layers.
boundaries.distribution: Per-OS bundles (deb via tauri-build --bundles deb, NSIS *setup.exe) + signing provenance, no runtime manifest redefinition.

non_boundary_note: Separate Rust crates are not a boundary: single package, root Cargo.toml members = ["rust/pokecon"]. Public Rust library API is not a boundary: src/lib.rs crate-private modules, only MainError/run_cli re-exported. server pub mod is crate-internal (lib.rs declares `mod server;`, handoff 5.1). Python cdylib/binding crate is retired (8726b23).
note: Scope limits: source_refs line anchors are range-checked only (file must exist, anchor line must be within range); symbol_anchors regexes are the primary liveness signal. Closed-world marker classes: [[bin]] names in rust/pokecon/Cargo.toml, cfg(target_os sites, WorkerLaunch::managed spawn constructor, security.rs enforcement, worker IPC schema/codec, dist/tauri + signing manifests. Test-only bins (fault fixtures) and macro-generated code are out of scope and documented in the contract_sync check.
